# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 40 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Eve's Lament; Seth Comforts Her

---

**1** Eve fell on her face before the gate of paradise, weeping: 'O God, forgive me! I have brought such great sorrow upon all my children.'

**2** Seth came to comfort Eve: 'Mother, don't weep. God is merciful to all who repent.'

**3** Eve said: 'Seth, my son — who will comfort me in my old age? I am alone.'

**4** Seth said: 'God will comfort you, mother, just as he has comforted everyone who has called on him.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
